title: Isolation of Axenic Symbiodinium Cultures
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qxzdxp6

steps.title: Disrupt anemones to release algae
steps.instruction: Use a glass homogenizer to disrupt several anemones, taking care to keep the algal cells largely intact.

steps.title: Pellet and wash algae with antibiotics
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the algal suspension at 1,000 g, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in filter‑sterilized artificial seawater (ASW) containing 50 µg mL⁻¹ kanamycin, 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin, and 50 µg mL⁻¹ streptomycin (KAS). Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation several times.

steps.title: Prepare solid IMK medium with antibiotics
steps.instruction: Make solid IMK agar plates and add the KAS antibiotic cocktail after autoclaving.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 g agar to 90 mL ASW and autoclave at 122 °C for 30 min.
Allow the molten medium to cool to approximately 65 °C.
Add sterile 10× Daigo’s IMK medium stock solution and the KAS antibiotics (50 µg mL⁻¹ kanamycin, 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin, 50 µg mL⁻¹ streptomycin).
Pour the medium into sterile petri dishes and let it solidify.

steps.title: Plate algae on solid medium
steps.instruction: Spread the washed algal suspension onto the prepared solid IMK + KAS plates and incubate for colony development.

substeps.instruction: Dispense varying amounts of algal suspension onto separate plates to obtain isolated colonies.
Wrap plates with parafilm to prevent evaporation and drying.
Incubate at the appropriate temperature; visible colonies typically appear after ~30 days (time may vary).

steps.title: Sterilize inoculation loop
steps.instruction: Flame‑sterilize an inoculation loop and allow it to cool to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Pick and streak single colonies
steps.instruction: Isolate individual colonies under a microscope and obtain a pure axenic line by repeated streaking.

substeps.instruction: Using the cooled inoculation loop, pick a single colony and streak onto a fresh solid IMK + KAS plate.
Incubate and examine for colony purity.
Repeat the picking‑and‑streaking procedure until a clean single colony is obtained.

steps.title: Screen colonies on Marine Broth
steps.instruction: Transfer each putative axenic colony onto a rich solid Marine Broth (MB) plate and observe for bacterial growth.

steps.title: Confirm bacterial absence by 16S PCR
steps.instruction: If no growth appears on MB, extract DNA from the colony and perform 16S rRNA PCR to detect bacterial contamination.

substeps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from the colony/cells grown on the MB plate.
Set up PCR reactions containing 0.3 M of each primer in 2× GoTaq Master Mix (Promega).
Thermal cycling: 94 °C 5 min; 30 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 50 °C 1 min, 72 °C 1.5 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min.
Use either primer set 1 (63F: CAGGCCTAACACATGCAAGTC / 1542R: AAGGAGGTGATCCAGCCGCA) or set 2 (27F: AGAGTTTGATCCTGGCTCAG / 1492R: GGTTACCTTGTTACGACTT).

steps.title: Determine Symbiodinium clade by PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify Symbiodinium 18S and chloroplast Cp23S regions to assign clade identity.

substeps.instruction: Use the same extracted DNA as template.
Perform PCR with 18S‑F (GGTTGATCCTGCCAGTAGTCATATGCTTG) / 18S‑R (GATCCTTCCGCAGGTTCACCTACGGAAACC) primers and Cp23S‑F (GACGGCTGTAACTATAACGG) / Cp23S‑R (CCATCGTATTGAACCCAGC) primers.
Follow the detailed protocol available at https://www.protocols.io/view/symbiodinium-cp23s-rflp-and-sequence-analysis-qyjdxun.

steps.title: Microscopic verification of axenic culture
steps.instruction: Examine the culture by fluorescence microscopy after fixation, washing, and DAPI staining to confirm the absence of bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Fix cells in 4 % paraformaldehyde at 4 °C for >1 hour.
Wash the fixed cells six times with PBS buffer.
Stain the cells with DAPI.
Observe under bright‑field and fluorescence microscopy; absence of bacterial signals indicates an axenic culture (example image scale bar 3 µm).
